C: › a white or grey bird, often used as a symbol of peace
› a person in politics who prefers to solve problems using peaceful methods instead of force or violence

NONE: › a small building for doves or similar birds to live in
› a type of joint used to fix two pieces of wood firmly together
› to cause something to fit exactly together

example: Their results dovetail nicely with ours.
他們的結果與我們的非常吻合。
We tried to dovetail our plans with theirs.
我們試圖把我們的計劃與他們的計劃銜接起來。

NONE: › supporting discussion or other peaceful solutions in political relationships rather than the use of force

example: He is a dovish politican who was one of the signers of a model peace treaty.
